title: Pipit
blurb: The pipits are a cosmopolitan genus, Anthus, of small passerine birds with medium to long tails. Along with the wagtails and longclaws, the pipits make up the family Motacillidae.
facts: The genus is widespread, occurring across most of the world, except the driest deserts, rainforest and the mainland of Antarctica.
